source: Owned diskless QEMU HDA fixture; 440/880 Hz stereo tones; static VGA desktop.
guest_cpu: Explicit distinct allowed CPU selected by root.
qualification: Owned static-tone guest, 24 fixed positions. Kernel netem delays data and TCP acknowledgments by 40 ms per direction at 1 Mbit/s per direction, using kernel queue byte accounting. No intentional loss; every measured queue must report zero drops. Not a real WAN or motion workload.
comparison: Explicit false versus true TCP_NODELAY, with native accepted-socket readback from the WebSocket hello.
kernel_source_rfb: Unshaped third priority band; filters match only the owned native HTTP/WebSocket port.
kernel_segmentation: Loopback MTU and segmentation offloads remain at their namespace defaults.
